G3900.def: from «3895»; a side-slip (lapse or deviation), i.e. (unintentional) error or (wilful) transgression:--fall, fault, offence, sin, trespass.

G3901.def: from «3844» and the alternate of «4482»; to flow by, i.e. (figuratively) carelessly pass (miss):--let slip.

G3902.def: from «3844» and the base of «4591»; side-marked, i.e. labelled (with a badge (figure-head) of a ship):--sign.

G3903.def: from «3844» and a derivative of «4632»; to furnish aside, i.e. get ready:--prepare self, be (make) ready.

G3905.def: from «3844» and teino (to stretch); to extend along, i.e. prolong (in point of time):--continue.

G3906.def: from «3844» and «5083»; to inspect alongside, i.e. note insidiously or scrupulously:--observe, watch.

G3908.def: from «3844» and «5087»; to place alongside, i.e. present (food, truth); by implication, to deposit (as a trust or for protection):--allege, commend, commit (the keeping of), put forth, set before.

G3909.def: from «3844» and «5177»; to chance near, i.e. fall in with:--meet with.

G3910.def: from «3844» and a derivative of «846»; at the very instant, i.e. momentary:--but for a moment.

G3911.def: from «3844» and «5342» (including its alternate forms); to bear along or aside, i.e. carry off (literally or figuratively); by implication, to avert:--remove, take away.

G3912.def: from «3844» and «5426»; to misthink, i.e. be insane (silly):--as a fool.

G3914.def: from «3844» and «5492»; to winter near, i.e. stay with over the rainy season:--winter.

G3916.def: from «3844» and «5536» (in its original sense); at the thing itself, i.e. instantly:--forthwith, immediately, presently, straightway, soon.

G3917.def: feminine of pardos (a panther); a leopard:--leopard.

G3918.def: from «3844» and «1510» (including its various forms); to be near, i.e. at hand; neuter present participle (singular) time being, or (plural) property:--come, × have, be here, + lack, (be here) present.

G3919.def: from «3844» and «1521»; to lead in aside, i.e. introduce surreptitiously:--privily bring in.

G3920.def: from «3919»; smuggled in: unawares brought in.

G3921.et: from (3844) and a compound of (1519) and (1416)
G3921.def: from «3844» and a compound of «1519» and «1416»; to settle in alongside, i.e. lodge stealthily:--creep in unawares.

G3922.def: from «3844» and «1525»; to come in alongside, i.e. supervene additionally or steathily:--come in privily, enter.

G3923.def: from «3844» and «1533»; to bear in alongside, i.e. introduce simultaneously:--give.

G3924.def: from «3844» and «1622»; near outside, i.e. besides:--except, saving, without.

G3925.def: from a compound of «3844» and «1685»; a throwing in beside (juxtaposition), i.e. (specially), battle-array, encampment or barracks (tower Antonia):--army, camp, castle.

G3926.def: from «3844» and «1776»; to harass further, i.e. annoy:--trouble.

G3927.def: from «3844» and the base of «1927»; an alien alongside, i.e. a resident foreigner:--pilgrim, stranger.

G3928.def: from «3844» and «2064»; to come near or aside, i.e. to approach (arrive), go by (or away), (figuratively) perish or neglect, (causative) avert:--come (forth), go, pass (away, by, over), past, transgress.

G3930.def: from «3844» and «2192»; to hold near, i.e. present, afford, exhibit, furnish occasion:--bring, do, give, keep, minister, offer, shew, + trouble.

G3931.et: from a compound of (3844) and a derivative of (58) (meaning to harangue an assembly)
G3931.def: from a compound of «3844» and a derivative of «58» (meaning to harangue an assembly); an address alongside, i.e. (specially), consolation:--comfort.

G3933.def: of unknown origin; a maiden; by implication, an unmarried daughter:--virgin.

G3934.def: probably of foreign origin; a Parthian, i.e. inhabitant of Parthia:--Parthian.

G3935.def: from «3844» and hiemi (to send); to let by, i.e. relax:--hang down.

G3936.def: from «3844» and «2476»; to stand beside, i.e. (transitively) to exhibit, proffer, (specially), recommend, (figuratively) substantiate; or (intransitively) to be at hand (or ready), aid:--assist, bring before, command, commend, give presently, present, prove, provide, shew, stand (before, by, here, up, with), yield.

G3937.et: probably by contraction for Parmenides (a derivative of a compound of (3844) and (3306))
G3937.def: probably by contraction for Parmenides (a derivative of a compound of «3844» and «3306»); constant; Parmenas, a Christian:--Parmenas.

G3938.def: from «3844» and «3598»; a by-road, i.e. (actively) a route:--way.

G3939.def: from «3844» and «3611»; to dwell near, i.e. reside as a foreigner:--sojourn in, be a stranger.

G3941.def: from «3844» and «3624»; having a home near, i.e. (as noun) a by-dweller (alien resident):--foreigner, sojourn, stranger.

G3942.et: from a compound of (3844) and perhaps a derivative of (3633)
G3942.def: from a compound of «3844» and perhaps a derivative of «3633»; apparently a state alongside of supposition, i.e. (concretely) an adage; specially, an enigmatical or fictitious illustration:--parable, proverb.

G3943.def: from «3844» and «3631»; staying near wine, i.e. tippling (a toper):--given to wine.

G3944.def: from «3844» and oichomai (to depart); to escape along, i.e. be gone:--past.

G3946.def: from «3844» and «3664»; alike nearly, i.e. similar:--like.

G3947.def: from «3844» and a derivative of «3691»; to sharpen alongside, i.e. (figuratively) to exasperate:--easily provoke, stir.

G3948.def: from «3947» ("paroxysm"); incitement (to good), or dispute (in anger):--contention, provoke unto.

G3949.def: from «3844» and «3710»; to anger alongside, i.e. enrage:--anger, provoke to wrath.

G3951.def: from «3844» and otruno (to spur); to urge along, i.e. stimulate (to hostility):--stir up.

G3952.def: from the present participle of «3918»; a being near, i.e. advent (often, return; specially, of Christ to punish Jerusalem, or finally the wicked); (by implication) physically, aspect:--coming, presence.

G3953.def: from «3844» and the base of «3795»; a side-dish (the receptacle):--platter.

G3954.def: from «3956» and a derivative of «4483»; all out-spokenness, i.e. frankness, bluntness, publicity; by implication, assurance:--bold (X -ly, -ness, -ness of speech), confidence, × freely, × openly, × plainly(-ness).

G3955.def: middle voice from «3954»; to be frank in utterance, or confident in spirit and demeanor:--be (wax) bold, (preach, speak) boldly.

G3956.et: including all the forms of declension
G3956.def: including all the forms of declension; apparently a primary word; all, any, every, the whole:--all (manner of, means), alway(-s), any (one), × daily, + ever, every (one, way), as many as, + no(-thing), × thoroughly, whatsoever, whole, whosoever.

G3957.def: of Chaldee origin (compare «06453»); the Passover (the meal, the day, the festival or the special sacrifices connected with it):--Easter, Passover.

G3958.def: apparently a primary verb; to experience a sensation or impression (usually painful):--feel, passion, suffer, vex.

G3959.def: probably of foreign origin; Patara, a place in Asia Minor:--Patara.

G3960.def: probably prolongation from «3817»; to knock (gently or with a weapon or fatally):--smite, strike. Compare «5180».

G3961.et: from a derivative probably of (3817) (meaning a "path")
G3961.def: from a derivative probably of «3817» (meaning a "path"); to trample (literally or figuratively):--tread (down, under foot).

G3962.def: apparently a primary word; a "father" (literally or figuratively, near or more remote):--father, parent.

G3963.def: of uncertain derivation; Patmus, an islet in the Mediterranean:--Patmos.

G3964.et: from (3962) and the same as the latter part of (3389)
G3964.def: from «3962» and the same as the latter part of «3389»; a parricide:--murderer of fathers.

G3965.def: as if feminine of a derivative of «3962»; paternal descent, i.e. (concretely) a group of families or a whole race (nation):--family, kindred, lineage.

G3968.def: from «3902»; a father-land, i.e. native town; (figuratively) heavenly home:--(own) country.

G3969.et: perhaps countr. for Patrobios (a compound of (3962) and (979))
G3969.def: perhaps a contraction for Patrobios (a compound of «3962» and «979»); father's life; Patrobas, a Christian:--Patrobas.

G3970.et: from (3962) and a derivative of (3860) (in the sense of handing over or down)
G3970.def: from «3962» and a derivative of «3860» (in the sense of handing over or down); traditionary:--received by tradition from fathers.

G3972.def: of Latin origin; (little; but remotely from a derivative of «3973», meaning the same); Paulus, the name of a Roman and of an apostle:--Paul, Paulus.

G3973.def: a primary verb ("pause"); to stop (transitively or intransitively), i.e. restrain, quit, desist, come to an end:--cease, leave, refrain.

G3974.def: of uncertain derivation; Paphus, a place in Cyprus:--Paphos.

G3975.def: from a derivative of «4078» (meaning thick); to thicken, i.e. (by implication) to fatten (figuratively, stupefy or render callous):--wax gross.

G3976.def: ultimately from «4228»; a shackle for the feet:--fetter.

G3977.et: from a derivative of (4228) (meaning the ground)
G3977.def: from a derivative of «4228» (meaning the ground); level (as easy for the feet):--plain.

G3978.def: from the same as «3979»; to foot a journey, i.e. travel by land:--go afoot.

G3979.et: dative case feminine of a derivative of (4228) (as adv)
G3979.def: dative case feminine of a derivative of «4228» (as adverb); foot-wise, i.e. by walking:--a- (on) foot.

G3980.def: from a compound of «3982» and «757»; to be persuaded by a ruler, i.e. (genitive case) to submit to authority; by analogy, to conform to advice:--hearken, obey (magistrates).

G3982.def: a primary verb; to convince (by argument, true or false); by analogy, to pacify or conciliate (by other fair means); reflexively or passively, to assent (to evidence or authority), to rely (by inward certainty):--agree, assure, believe, have confidence, be (wax) conflent, make friend, obey, persuade, trust, yield.

G3983.et: from the same as (3993) (through the idea of pinching toil; "pine")
G3983.def: from the same as «3993» (through the idea of pinching toil; "pine"); to famish (absolutely or comparatively); figuratively, to crave:--be an hungered.

G3984.et: from the base of (4008) (through the idea of piercing)
G3984.def: from the base of «4008» (through the idea of piercing); a test, i.e. attempt, experience:--assaying, trial.

G3985.def: from «3984»; to test (objectively), i.e. endeavor, scrutinize, entice, discipline:--assay, examine, go about, prove, tempt(-er), try.

G3986.def: from «3985»; a putting to proof (by experiment (of good), experience (of evil), solicitation, discipline or provocation); by implication, adversity:--temptation, × try.

G3987.def: from «3984»; to test (subjectively), i.e. (reflexively) to attempt:--assay.

G3988.def: from a presumed derivative of «3982»; persuadableness, i.e. credulity:--persuasion.

G3989.def: of uncertain affinity; deep or open sea, i.e. the main:--depth, sea.

G3990.et: from a derivative of (4141) (meaning an axe)
G3990.def: from a derivative of «4141» (meaning an axe); to chop off (the head), i.e. truncate:--behead.

G3992.def: apparently a primary verb; to dispatch (from the subjective view or point of departure, whereas hiemi (as a stronger form of eimi) refers rather to the objective point or terminus ad quem, and «4724» denotes properly, the orderly motion involved), especially on a temporary errand; also to transmit, bestow, or wield:--send, thrust in.

G3993.et: from a primary peno (to toil for daily subsistence)
G3993.def: from a primary peno (to toil for daily subsistence); starving, i.e. indigent:--poor. Compare «4434».

G3994.def: feminine of «3995»; a wife's mother:--mother in law, wife's mother.

G3995.def: of uncertain affinity; a wife's father:--father in law.

G3996.def: from «3997»; to grieve (the feeling or the act):--mourn, (be-)wail.

G3997.def: strengthened from the alternate of «3958»; grief:--mourning, sorrow.

G3998.def: prolongation from the base of «3993»; necessitous:--poor.

G3999.def: multiplicative adverb from «4002»; five times:--five times.
